narrative:
Capital expenditure of about EUR 86M a year funds clinic modernisation and energy efficiency, outpatient rehab centre expansion, medical and therapy equipment, digital therapy and the data platform, and the integration of the Paracelsus clinics.

Every programme carries its own depreciation profile and can be compared with its occupancy and revenue effect before approval.

signals.title: High double-digit EUR million investment programme
signals.excerpt: Investment in outpatient rehab, clinic modernisation and digital therapy.

signals.title: Nine Paracelsus rehabilitation clinics integrated (2025)
signals.excerpt: Nine rehabilitation clinics acquired from Paracelsus add German inpatient rehab capacity; occupancy ramp-up is the key FY2027 assumption.
